name: vane-1-rc1
purpose: Round-9 baseline: the round-5 pilot setup (vane-1-rc0) on the new base, Granite R2 97m. Learns whether the same 1,875 pairs move Granite on v1 dev. Not a release candidate: no export, no publication, no default change.

data.pairs: training/data/vane1-pilot/pairs-clean.jsonl (reused from the pilot; 2026-11-24: 1,875 rows, check_overlap.py 0 overlap with all of nai-bench, train.load_pairs guard passed: authors mistral-small3.1 + EU/US/SE/DE official texts)
data.rule: public domain, CC0, CC-BY, EU reuse texts and teacher-generated text only; no CC-BY-SA; nothing from nai-bench

command: docker compose -f training/docker/compose.rocm.yaml run --rm trainer sh -c 'mkdir -p training/runs/vane1-rc1 && timeout 3h python3 training/embed/train.py --pairs training/data/vane1-pilot/pairs-clean.jsonl --output-dir training/runs/vane1-rc1 --base-model ibm-granite/granite-embedding-97m-multilingual-r2 --release vane-1-rc1 --epochs 1 --batch-size 64 --learning-rate 2e-5 --max-seq-length 256 --hard-negatives 1 --eval-steps 100 --seed 13 --no-export > training/runs/vane1-rc1/train.log 2>&1'
limits: unattended, capped at 3 hours (timeout 3h), log in training/runs/vane1-rc1/train.log
evaluation: evals/embeddings/dense_eval.py on the v1 dev split only: rc1 vs plain granite97, the MiniLM pilot (rc0) and MiniLM base, embedding-only; hybrid via RRF with nAI's BM25 order; per category, language and cross-language
release_label: vane-1-rc1 (baseline on Granite; not a release candidate in the release sense)
